form.consentText: Allow FlipForge to use this sale, without my name or account details, in anonymized, aggregated market research and comparisons. Optional; I can change this at any time.

limitations: Reported sales are the customer's own records, labelled USER_REPORTED. Submitting a sale never makes it verified.
Reported sales are not used in market comparisons, pricing, outcome research or model learning in this phase.
Realized profit uses the customer's recorded acquisition cost and the fees the customer entered; taxes are not included.
Buyer details are not collected. A transaction reference is kept only as a fingerprint and its last four characters.
Recording a sale never rescores, reranks or changes a saved FlipForge decision, and authorizes no transaction.
